site.intro: I’m Noam Favier — a software developer with a passion for building bold, intelligent systems that push boundaries. With six years of hands-on experience across Go, Python, Java, C, and more, I specialize in crafting high-performance tools, immersive games, and AI-driven applications. I run NF Software, an independent studio building developer tools, local-first software, and custom work. There I’m developing Iris, a fully offline AI suite — a voice assistant, an agent framework, and a physics-based memory graph, all running on your own machine — alongside BitVoyager, a gamified platform that makes learning to code engaging and intuitive. My goal? To bridge the gap between humans and machines—through design, code, and a relentless drive to rethink what software can be.
